subject: Error when attempting to estimate bootstrap ci using boot.ci.type = "bca.simple"

messages.author: 21fcc60000cb93aa
messages.subject: Error when attempting to estimate bootstrap ci using boot.ci.type = "bca.simple"
parts:
Dear all,

when attempting to estimate bootstrap confidence intervals for model parameters using the boot.ci.type = "bca.simple" argument, I receive the following error message (see attached screenshot):

Error in if (!all(rk > 1 & rk < R)) warning("extreme order statistics used as endpoints") : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed


Bootstrapping using all other methods performs well with the same model and data.

Does anyone have an idea what we did wrong here?



Thank you very much for your help!
Friedemann
